notes.title: Custom Game Update
notes.content: [p]This update allows you to customize the game default settings for the Freeplay mode. Customize each run to your liking to either make the game easier or more challenging![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210017/d5ff6489f56a80981131da3169cc4482816c5d04.png"][/img][/p]
